name: Your own channels
description: 24/7 Live TV channels made from your own films and shows, in the Live TV guide beside your other channels. Watching one joins whatever is on, part-way through, like real TV.
author: Atomix

settings.label: Channels, one per line: Name = library, genre, show, collection or playlist and its name (add “, in order” to play in order instead of shuffled)
settings.default:
Movie Night = library Movies
Comedy Channel = genre Comedy
